tetA_tetracycline_efflux.name: AMRFinderPlus
tetA_tetracycline_efflux.binary_endpoint: POSITIVE iff a reported gene symbol normalizes to teta, tet(a), tetb, or tet(b). Other tet classes are NEGATIVE for this exact endpoint. Failed runs are comparator failures, not truth.

tetA_tetracycline_efflux.name: Conventional
tetA_tetracycline_efflux.database_version: frozen tetA family member sequences packaged with the freeze
tetA_tetracycline_efflux.binary_endpoint: POSITIVE if conventional homology call detects the target; otherwise NEGATIVE; unresolved is COMPARATOR_UNRESOLVED

tetA_tetracycline_efflux.name: GS-Deterministic V4.1
tetA_tetracycline_efflux.binary_endpoint: POSITIVE if validator claim_type is target_gene_detected; NEGATIVE if target_gene_not_detected; else unresolved/failed-closed

rpoB_RNAP_beta.name: NCBI RefSeq PGAP CDS annotation
rpoB_RNAP_beta.software: NCBI RefSeq annotated assembly distribution (no local PGAP re-run; no eggNOG-mapper)
rpoB_RNAP_beta.software_version: annotation files shipped with the selected GCF assembly version
rpoB_RNAP_beta.database_version: GCF assembly version; *_genomic.gff.gz from the same ftp_path, fallback *_feature_table.txt.gz
rpoB_RNAP_beta.binary_endpoint: POSITIVE if any CDS has gene=rpoB or a product naming RNA polymerase subunit beta that is not beta-prime/rpoC. NEGATIVE if annotation is present and has zero rpoB hits. UNCERTAIN if annotation missing/unreadable/no CDS.
